predefinedQueries.queryString: select codice_azienda,id_scan,id_anagrafica,id_somministrazione,dynamo_user,date_of_scan,entrasp.anagrafiche_vr_dati_identificativi('€global_codice_part€', id_anagrafica) as descr_anagrafica,entrasp.onekyc_describe_aml_scan_data(scan_data) as descr_scan_data, CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' ELSE 'Deep Scan' END as scan_type from imports.aml_scans where codice_azienda='€global_codice_azienda€'

querySuffixes.tableViewSuffix: order by date_of_scan desc, id_somministrazione desc limit 400

tableQueries.label: Admin: estrazioni per tipo e mese
tableQueries.queryString: select codice_azienda, extract(year from date_of_scan) as anno, extract(month from date_of_scan) as mese, CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' ELSE 'Deep Scan' END as scan_type, count(id_scan) as conta_per_scan, count(distinct id_anagrafica) as conta_per_anagrafica from imports.aml_scans where codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) group by codice_azienda,extract(year from date_of_scan), extract(month from date_of_scan),(CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' ELSE 'Deep Scan' end) order by codice_azienda, extract(year from date_of_scan), extract(month from date_of_scan)

tableQueries.label: Estrazioni per tipo e mese
tableQueries.queryString: select codice_azienda, extract(year from date_of_scan) as anno, extract(month from date_of_scan) as mese, CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' ELSE 'Deep Scan' END as scan_type, count(id_scan) as conta_per_scan, count(distinct id_anagrafica) as conta_per_anagrafica from imports.aml_scans where codice_azienda in(€global_user_companies€) group by codice_azienda,extract(year from date_of_scan), extract(month from date_of_scan),(CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' ELSE 'Deep Scan' end) where codice_azienda=$codice_azienda$ order by codice_azienda,  extract(year from date_of_scan), extract(month from date_of_scan)

format.comboQuery: SELECT DISTINCT tipo_scan AS id, tipo_scan AS name FROM imports.aml_scans WHERE codice_azienda='€global_codice_azienda€';

search_keys.label: Tipo scansione
search_keys.queryCond: (CASE scan_data->>'scanType' WHEN 'LIGHTSCAN' THEN 'Light Scan' else 'Deep scan' end)=$tipo_scansione$

format.comboQuery: SELECT DISTINCT dynamo_user AS id, dynamo_user AS name FROM imports.aml_scans WHERE codice_azienda='€global_codice_azienda€' order by dynamo_user;

select distinct mt.id_modello_test as id, mt.id_modello_test||'-'||mt.titolo as name from imports.aml_scans inner join entrasp.sondaggi_somministrati ss using (codice_azienda, id_somministrazione)  inner join entrasp.sondaggi snd using (codice_azienda, id_sondaggio) inner join entrasp.modelli_test mt on snd.codice_azienda=mt.codice_azienda and snd.id_modello_Test=mt.id_modello_test where mt.codice_Azienda='€global_codice_azienda€'

search_keys.label: Modello test
search_keys.queryCond: codice_azienda||'-'||id_somministrazione in(select ss.codice_azienda||'-'||ss.id_somministrazione from entrasp.sondaggi_somministrati ss inner join entrasp.sondaggi snd using(codice_azienda, id_sondaggio) where snd.id_modello_test=$mt_s$ and snd.codice_azienda='€global_codice_azienda€')
